summary.answer: Hud_WZ directly constructs this result widget. SetupGameEndScoreWidget and DisableAutoButtonCallback run first; demo.processedKeyframeJump and lobbyRoot.publicLobby.stage are initialized to0 (real model writes, not backend stage proof). Builds result/outcome/eliminator/status/timer/deathcam/VOIP/quit/placement/killer/weapon/AAR/director/crosshair children. The constructor requests a GameScore/titleString subscription. Only if its callback is delivered and model:get() is nonnil, it requests LocalizeToUpperString with that value and passes the unknown result to Outcome:setText, if earlier accesses/calls succeed; nil takes no explicit setText arm. Callback delivery, localization/case result and displayed effect remain unresolved; aliveTeammateCount drives DownNotOut art; GameScore model forwarded to eliminator/challenge/killer/weapon displays. Victory controls challenge coin visibility. meansOfDeath>0 hides killer/weapon displays and inversely reveals self-caused/means-of-death displays. Attacker identity model rebinding first removes and nils old per-field subscription, dereferences new attackerClientModel, then subscribes xuid/clientNum/rank/rankIcon; analogous clientModel rebinding populates MistakesWereMade identity. Calling card receives full client model; nonnil callbacks update emblem/name/cleaned clan/rank/icon. No nil update clears old displayed text explicitly. VOIP HudStart has a recovered early-return/branch shape (exact trace) and ShowForCodCaster AlwaysFalse; do not replace it with an assumed visibility formula. Outcome state family: ShowOutcomeTransition with no killcam -> Victory/PC; defeat/team_elimination with no killcam -> Defeat/GameOver variants; elimination -> Elimination. Platoon variants additionally platoonCount!=0; PC variants additionally IsPC. Non-PC named states do not themselves contain not-IsPC, so do not assume exclusivity; LUI arbitration stays external. State/current/visibility/profile/lobby/teammate/AAR/input subscriptions reevaluate state/buttons. Square prioritizes console spectate (hide AAR/send skip_deathcam/clear transition/location/hide occluder), then console online AAR close under ui_showWZAAR/noncustom/not-spectate. Triangle redeploy requires private host, all members can redeploy, no matchmaking, redeploy_enabled and noncustom. Cross console deathcam requires eligibility, non-PC, not alternate killcam button, not UI-active/demo/default and viewed report; sends play_deathcam, sets hasPlayedDeathCam, plays alias/music. Circle console hold-finished quits; PC branches quit on non-held conditions; contextual2 handles PC exit. Each action returns true when taken, label callbacks often return false despite valid action, exact source retained. setState CallOriginalFirst hook branches demo/console/PC-occluded focus/intro/cursor/chat behavior; keyframeJump clears transition only during demo. Close is registered via CallOriginalSecond to an unselected __onClose; optional postload then focus/safe-area setup and return.
